editorial.blurb: A storied pub where history comes alive through thoughtful decor and genuinely hospitable service, with hearty British and Irish classics that hit the mark.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about the house special when you arrive—past guests raved about the beef stew in red wine sauce—and arrive early enough to snag a seat by the memorabilia if you want to chat with owner Colin about his family's military history.
signatureDishes: Beef Stew in Red Wine Sauce
